items.item_text: cover letter
references

The successful candidate will possess a Doctoral degree from a United States Department of Education recognized, accredited program and be a registered and licensed occupational therapist in the state of California, with at least three years of clinical practice experience as an occupational therapist.
Ensure compliance with ACOTE capstone requirements.
Procure and develop capstone education sites that fit with course content and curriculum design.
Provide development to capstone community mentors and faculty mentors to support student learning experiences.
Place students in capstone sites.
Support students while on capstone.
Oversee administration of capstone requirements of clinical affiliation agreements, student health records, site-specific requirements, and utilization of the healthcare education management system.
Manage and teach capstone courses.
Engage in service activities for the Institute.
Provide active, innovative, and high-caliber learning experiences in relevant areas of expertise, including general practice, professional, and capstone-related courses.
Participate in scholarly activities of research and program development in collaboration with OTD faculty.
Serve on OTD program, SHS, and KGI committees as assigned.
Provide student advisement and mentorship.
Engage in institutional and governance activities.
Support and promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in all aspects of capstone education.
Demonstrate professional skills and interactions that support the mission and vision of the OTD program.
Other duties as assigned.
Strong attention to detail.
Proficient computer, online system, and web skills.
Strong work ethic and team-based approach to working in a high-volume environment.
Superior writing skills.
Positive, welcoming personality with demonstrated customer service experience.
Ability to maintain the highest level of confidentiality.
Ability to work comfortably, respectfully, and competently with people of diverse backgrounds.
Ability to handle multiple responsibilities simultaneously.
Available for occasional work on evenings and weekends, as event schedules may require.
